title: Machine Learning & NLP Basics I Learned at AIUB
description:
Natural Language Processing always fascinated me because human language is messy, nuanced, and full of ambiguity. In our AI & Data Science coursework at AIUB, I transitioned from theoretical math to building hands-on predictive models with Python, Pandas, and Scikit-Learn.

My first text classification project explored sentiment and topic detection using TF-IDF (Term Frequency - Inverse Document Frequency) paired with Naive Bayes and Logistic Regression. Learning to clean raw text—tokenization, stopword removal, and lemmatization—revealed that 80% of data science success depends on thoughtful data preprocessing.

Evaluating models using Confusion Matrices, Precision, Recall, and F1-Scores rather than just raw accuracy was an eye-opener. It showed me how models behave when classes are imbalanced and gave me a solid foundation for exploring modern LLMs and Transformers.
